versions.objective:
Task (single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions — pick sane defaults and document them): write deploy-ready smart contracts for "$ADAM", an Ethereum mainnet memecoin on Uniswap v4. Swap fees buy $IMD and $PNKSTR and distribute them to ADAM holders.

## Token + hook
- ADAM ERC-20, fixed supply 1,000,000,000, no mint. Owner can only LOWER fees, never raise.
- Uniswap v4 ETH/ADAM pool, PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. Launch without ETH: single-sided ADAM-only position above current price.
- Hook: 1.5% fee on every buy and sell, taken in ETH, sent to Treasury. No heavy logic inside swaps.
- Anti-snipe: fee starts at 20% and decays linearly to 1.5% over the first 30 minutes (same split applies).

## Fee split (fixed in code)
- 10% → teamWallet (constructor param).
- 90% → holders:
  - 50% buys $IMD (0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7) via its existing v4 ETH/IMD pool (find the PoolKey onchain).
  - 50% buys $PNKSTR (0xc50673edb3a7b94e8cad8a7d4e0cd68864e33edf) via its v4 pool:
    PoolKey { currency0: ETH (address(0)), currency1: PNKSTR, fee: 0, tickSpacing: 60, hooks: 0xfaaad5b731f52cdc9746f2414c823eca9b06e844 }.
    The PNKSTR hook is unverified and charges a buy tax — measure the real tax on a mainnet fork and account for it in minOut.
- Both buys: slippage cap + max size per call to limit MEV.

## Distribution
- IMD + PNKSTR distributed to ADAM holders pro-rata to balance, pull-based claim (dividend-per-share pattern), updated on transfer, multiple reward tokens.
- Exclude pool, PoolManager, hook, Treasury, Distributor, zero/dead addresses.
- Treasury.process(): public, anyone can call — executes split, buys, pushes rewards to Distributor.
- Reentrancy guards, no upgradeability, no blacklist, no owner access to holder funds.

## Deliverables (all in this job)
1. Foundry repo: ADAM token, hook (mined hook-address flags), Treasury, Distributor, mainnet deploy script (NOT executed — deployer signs manually) with exact constructor params and step list.
2. Tests: unit + fuzz + mainnet-fork (real IMD and PNKSTR pools): buy/sell tax, 90/10 split, 50/50 IMD/PNKSTR, anti-snipe decay, process(), claims, exclusions, reentrancy, slippage limits.
3. Short self-audit: findings by severity, all fixes applied.
4. Short README: deploy, add single-sided liquidity, call process() on a schedule (hourly is enough), claim.
Out of scope: website, heartbeat, Sepolia deploy.

$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — continue the ADAM project from the parent job (single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions — pick sane defaults and document them). Keep everything already built and accepted (plain ERC-20 "ADAM", staking Distributor, hook, Treasury, anti-snipe, 90/10 split). Token name and symbol stay "ADAM". All distributions are pull-based: users claim themselves, nobody pushes tokens.

## 1. NFT holder claims with daily unlock
- New contract NFTClaim holding 11% of ADAM supply, funded in the deploy script:
  - IMD NFT 0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d: 10% of supply (100,000,000 ADAM).
  - Swarm Pepe 0x999ce0ce8c5f7661e0c74a568ffe27ceb9177bdb: 1% of supply (10,000,000 ADAM).
- Per NFT, not per wallet: each tokenId gets an equal share (collection allocation / collection size, read onchain at build, fixed immutably at deploy). The current ownerOf(tokenId) claims its unlocked share; claimed amounts tracked per tokenId. Batch claim for many tokenIds in one tx.
- Unlock: 10 equal daily tranches per tokenId — 10% of its share at launch, +10% every 24h, full after day 9 (= 1% of supply/day for IMD NFTs, 0.1%/day for Swarm Pepe).
- claimAndStake(tokenIds) claims and stakes into the Distributor in one tx; plain claim too.
- burnUnclaimed() after full unlock + 30 days → dead address (covers burned/never-claimed tokenIds).
- No owner withdraw, no parameter changes, reentrancy guard. NFTClaim earns no rewards.

## 2. Three reward assets, split by the IMD swarm oracle ("buy what's down")
- Reward assets for stakers:
  - $IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7 (existing ETH/IMD v4 pool)
  - $PNKSTR 0xc50673edb3a7b94e8cad8a7d4e0cd68864e33edf (existing ETH/PNKSTR v4 pool, 10% hook tax already measured)
  - $IMDSTR 0x80271ce20184e38f4afe90d4ca134304d197aca2 (TokenWorks NFTStrategy proxy, impl 0x7fb856425f164929f023055e8bc40e980b362f61, v4 hook 0x66b05c8eeca9329f7a2332c02ce3855cfab72444; find PoolKey onchain, measure hook tax on fork)
- Holder share (90%) split across the three by a daily signed IMD oracle report (imd.fun/docs/#oracle) from a heartbeat job: imdBps, pnkstrBps, imdstrBps (sum 10000) + short reason. Policy: favor what is down over 24h, unless liquidity/risk signals say otherwise.
- Contract: verify signature + freshness (≤ 26h), clamp each to 1500–7000 bps, missing/stale/invalid → equal thirds. Bounds immutable, owner cannot override. Emit SplitUpdated(imdBps, pnkstrBps, imdstrBps, reportId, reasonHash, source).
- If verifying the IMD oracle report onchain is not feasible, say so and fall back to onchain daily snapshots of the three pool prices with the same rule.
- Deliver the heartbeat job spec/prompt (inputs + output format).
- Keep existing per-leg limits, slippage floors, failure rerouting — extend to three legs.

## 3. IMDSTR transfer lock
- VERIFIED: IMDSTR wallet→wallet transfer() reverts InvalidTransfer() (0x2f352531); PoolManager is NOT a distributor.
- Implement buy-on-claim: IMDSTR share accrues per staker in ETH; on claim the Distributor swaps that ETH → IMDSTR via its v4 pool with take() directly to the claimer (claimer-supplied slippage).
- Support a one-time switch to direct distribution if the IMDSTR owner whitelists our Distributor via setDistributor.
- Fork test: buy-on-claim delivers IMDSTR to an EOA; direct transfer reverts without whitelist.

## 4. Keeper bounty
- process() pays the caller 0.5% of the ETH processed in that call (constant max), so bots call it hourly.

## 5. X / discoverability
- https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD in NatSpec header of every contract (@custom:x), ERC-7572 contractURI() on Distributor/Treasury (token stays plain), README top.

## Deliverables
1. Updated Foundry repo + deploy script (11% to NFTClaim; NOT broadcast — deployer signs manually).
2. Unit + fuzz + fork tests for everything above.
3. Short self-audit with fixes applied.
4. Updated README (claim flows, unlock schedule, oracle split, links).
Out of scope: website.

$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — independent security audit of the ADAM project (continue from parent job). Single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions.

## Scope
- All first-party contracts at the current head (PR #2): LaunchToken, AdamHook, AdamTreasuryV2, AdamDistributorV2, AdamSplitOracle, NFTClaim, plus script/DeployAdam.s.sol (hook-only mode) and script/DeployAdamExtension.s.sol.
- Intended mainnet setup: fresh ADAM token → DeployAdamExtension (oracle, DistributorV2, NFTClaim funded with 110,000,000 ADAM, TreasuryV2) → DeployAdam hook-only with TreasuryV2 → single-sided ETH/ADAM v4 pool. Legacy V1 Distributor/Treasury will NOT be deployed on mainnet.

## Process
- Independent reviewers (not the original author), each focused on: math/accounting, access control & immutability, economic/MEV attacks (process(), keeper bounty, reward legs, price floors, reroute), oracle verification (IMD Oracle v2 EIP-712 attestation, signer, questionHash, quorum, freshness, replay, clamps, fallback), NFTClaim (per-tokenId unlock, ownership checks, transfers mid-vesting, batch, claimAndStake, burnUnclaimed), IMDSTR buy-on-claim + one-time direct switch, deploy scripts (ordering, funding, hook mining, pool init, LP ticks).
- A judge consolidates findings.
- Fix every Critical / High / Medium finding with a regression test. Do NOT add features or change economics (fees, splits, allocations, unlock schedule, bounds).

## Deliverables
1. AUDIT.md: findings by severity with status (fixed / acknowledged + reasoning), and a mainnet deployment checklist with exact constructor parameters to verify.
2. Fixes + regression tests (unit, fuzz, mainnet fork). All tests green.
3. README updated only where behavior changed.
Nothing is broadcast; deployer signs manually.

$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — apply two changes from the independent audit (continue from parent job). Single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions. Keep everything else exactly as is: token, hook, fees, splits, oracle, NFTClaim, IMDSTR logic, bounds, keeper bounty.

## 1. Fix audit finding A-01 (just-in-time staking)
- AdamDistributorV2: unstake (and exit/withdraw of principal) is allowed only 24 hours after the wallet's most recent stake. Every new stake or stakeFor (incl. NFTClaim.claimAndStake) resets that wallet's 24h lock.
- Reward claims (claimReward, claimIMDSTR, any per-asset claim) stay available at any time; reward accounting unchanged.
- Expose unlockTime(wallet) view; revert with a clear custom error before the lock ends.
- Tests: stake → unstake before 24h reverts, after 24h succeeds; top-up resets lock; claimAndStake sets lock for the claimant; rewards claimable during lock; JIT scenario (stake right before process(), try to exit) now blocked; invariants/fuzz still green.

## 2. Permanent LP lock
- DeployAdam hook-only path: mint the single-sided ETH/ADAM LP position NFT directly to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD (recipient constant, not configurable). Nothing goes to the deployer.
- LIQUIDITY_ADAM default = 890,000,000 ADAM when used after DeployAdamExtension (still overridable downward only by explicit env).
- Fork test: after deploy, PositionManager ownerOf(lpId) == dead address, deployer holds no LP NFT, swaps work in both directions, liquidity cannot be decreased by deployer.

## Deliverables
1. Code changes + tests (unit, fuzz, fork). All green.
2. README + deployment checklist updated (lock, 24h unstake rule, LP burned).
3. Short changelog entry.
Nothing is broadcast; deployer signs manually.

$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — fix one griefing issue and review all changes since the audit (continue from parent job). Single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions. Change nothing else.

## 1. Fix
- Problem: AdamDistributorV2.stakeFor is permissionless and every stakeFor resets the recipient's 24h unlockTime, so anyone can stake 1 wei for a victim every <24h and lock the victim's principal forever.
- Fix: stakeFor may only be called by the immutable NFTClaim contract (used by claimAndStake). All other users stake for themselves via stake(). Revert with a clear custom error otherwise. No other path may let a third party reset someone's lock.
- Tests: third-party stakeFor reverts; claimAndStake still works and sets the claimant's lock; repeated 1-wei griefing impossible; JIT still blocked; all existing unit, fuzz, invariant and fork tests green.

## 2. Adversarial review of everything changed since audited commit 785edda
- Re-read with an attacker mindset: 24h lock (unlockTime, _lockStake, unstake/exit), stakeFor restriction, claimAndStake path, reward claims during lock, LP NFT minted to dead address, 890M default liquidity and downward-only override.
- Look for: griefing/DoS on unstake, JIT bypasses (second wallet, NFTClaim path), lock bypass, accounting drift, any way to withdraw the LP.
- Fix anything Critical/High/Medium with a regression test.

## Deliverables
Code + tests, REVIEW.md (findings by severity or explicit "no issues found" per item), CHANGELOG entry. Nothing broadcast.

$ADAM — official X: https://x.com/IaMaDamIMD — fix AdamSplitOracle so it works with daily IMD oracle runs (continue from parent job). Single job, do NOT ask clarifying questions. Change nothing else.

## Problem (verified against the live IMD API)
IMD's questionHash changes on every run because it includes the pinned block window (two quotes 30 s apart returned different hashes). The immutable questionHash check therefore rejects every daily report. Also, requests created on the IMD website are signed with a default EIP-712 domain verifyingContract (observed 0x37bfb8ac7c960e558657871d41ca70e07e7dbfff), not with our oracle's address.

## Fix
- Remove the immutable questionHash check.
- Add immutable `relayer` (constructor param). Only `relayer` may call submit(); others revert with a custom error. Mainnet value: 0x087Bada60BB18d1667F03a8BA6b2aE5394E0E2C5.
- Add immutable `domainVerifyingContract` (constructor param) used in the EIP-712 domain {name "IdentityMD Oracle", version "2", chainId, verifyingContract = domainVerifyingContract}. If zero is passed, use address(this). Do NOT use OZ EIP712's implicit address(this) when a value is set.
- Keep everything else: immutable signer, answerType 5, exactly four bytes32 words, bps sum 10000, reason hash check, panelSize >= 5, quorum >= 4, agreed >= quorum, freshness <= 26h, expiry, strictly increasing issuedAt, replay protection, clamps 1500–7000, equal-thirds fallback.
- Update DeployAdamExtension Config + mainnetConfig (relayer, domainVerifyingContract; drop questionHash), deploy-script checks, README, HEARTBEAT.md and checklist.

## Tests
Valid report from relayer accepted with both domain modes; non-relayer reverts; wrong domain / wrong signer / stale / replay / bad sum / low quorum rejected; different questionHash values across runs all accepted; all existing tests green.

## Deliverables
Code + tests, REVIEW.md section for this change, CHANGELOG. Nothing broadcast.
